name: OMP Desktop 0.1.4
body:
• Use OMP for every new chat; retire Pi history import and remote Pi hosts.
• Fix automatic memory capture and preserve project, worktree and temporary scopes.
• Improve memory settings spacing, search controls and narrow-window layouts.
• Recognize published thinking levels and image/PDF capabilities while preserving manual overrides.
• Open HTML references in the file manager, built-in browser or system default app.
• Announce completion after durable turn settlement.

• 新会话统一使用 OMP，关闭 Pi 历史导入和远程 Pi Host。
• 修复自动记忆保存，正确保留项目、worktree 和临时会话范围。
• 改善记忆设置间距、搜索控件与窄窗口布局。
• 识别发布的思考档位和图片/PDF 能力，保留手动覆盖。
• HTML 引用可用文件管理器、内置浏览器或系统默认应用打开。
• 回合持久化结算后再通知完成，避免恢复状态竞态。

### Installation and updates / 安装与更新

- Install 0.1.4 manually once over a 0.15.x test build because the version sequence has restarted. Existing OMP data stays in its own directory.
- 从 0.15.x 测试版首次切换到 0.1.4 需手动安装；原有 OMP 数据目录保留。
- 0.1.1 upgrades storage schema 21 to 22 after creating a backup. To return to 0.1.0, restore that backup while the app is closed. Full conversation branching, per-child stop and background-command controls are not included.
- 0.1.1 将存储 schema 21 升级至 22，升级前自动备份；回退 0.1.0 时需关闭应用并恢复该备份。本版不含完整会话分支、单独停止子代理及后台命令控制。
- Unsigned macOS builds use the GitHub download button for updates. If macOS blocks the first launch, follow OMP-Desktop-macOS-opening-help.txt in the ZIP package.
- 未签名 macOS 通过 GitHub 下载按钮更新；首次启动被系统阻止时，请按 ZIP 中的 OMP-Desktop-macOS-opening-help.txt 操作。
- The Windows installer and Linux AppImage support in-app updates. Portable Windows, Debian and RPM packages use manual downloads.
- Windows 安装版和 Linux AppImage 支持应用内更新；Windows 便携版、Debian 和 RPM 使用手动下载。
